entries.a9126e5608e2bde4: This business operates movie theaters and restaurants and is the largest business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥3,654 million (of which ¥3,484 million related to movie theaters and ¥170 million to restaurants). It operates 'Midland Square Cinema' and 'Midland Square Cinema 2' in Nakamura Ward, Nagoya, and 'Midland Cinema Nagoya Airport' in Toyoyama Town, Nishikasugai District, Aichi Prefecture. Midland Square Cinema is operated through a joint venture with Shochiku Multiplex Theaters Co., Ltd. (the company's share of the partnership's assets is 64%). In its restaurant-related operations, it runs the café 'Kakuozan Café Ji.Coo.' in Chikusa Ward, Nagoya, and sells food and drinks inside movie theaters.
